what: each source's own picks at every word place of the books receipt-v1 lists (the corpus lane's default picks v1, with the v1.1 mend of STEP's dictionary picks and the v1.2 mend of STEP's and BDB's picks), laid on the zones' words by WORD_N and counted by one rule: a pick's words are a line pick where they hold a letter or digit and are not NO DATA YET (a sign alone is no pick for any source); STEP has a line where its pick 1 is a line pick or the zone's place pieces all carry words, and where the line as it rests draws one (not at a pair, or a place call 4 writes with « | », where its own words are never drawn, the pieces do not answer and the record of the resting lines holds no line over the word: step_line_rests_bare); MACULA, UBS and BDB have a line where the word is not ketiv/qere and, for MACULA, its pick is a line pick, for UBS some piece's pick 1 is one, for BDB pick 1's record's highlighted words are one; fills[x][y] counts the places where x has no line and y has one, never a place where STEP's line rests bare; STEP's second fills only the places STEP leaves (no pick); where the page's own line is bare and STEP's pick 1 is a line pick of its reading, the line under STEP prints those words, credited to STEP (step_words). The second source is the page's to work out; the one named here is worked out with every source on

shape.book_file: data/default-picks/<book>.bin: gzip -9 of minified JSON; places[n - 1] for WORD_N n is null at a mark or where no source picks, else [step, macula, ubs, bdb], each 0 where the source has no pick; step [[kind 0 r | 1 v | 2 a, words | 0, a variant's letter], ...]; macula its words, as given; ubs [line | 0, [[piece (from 0, in the ledger's list of the word's pieces), words], ...]], the picks of a piece in its order, numbered from 1 within the piece by the page; bdb [[sense marker, or "" for the entry, one-based index into bdb_words | 0], ...]
shape.index: data/default-picks/index.json: sources (id, pill, M ids) and per book file, bytes, sha256, entries, places, kq, has, fills, step_leaves ([n, MACULA's line | 0, UBS's line | 0, [BDB's sense, BDB's words] | 0], one per place STEP leaves that is not ketiv/qere) and step_words ([n, STEP's pick 1 words], one per place that is not ketiv/qere, whose zone place pieces do not answer, where STEP's pick 1 is a line pick of its reading, and not where the corpus lane's call 4 writes STEP's words with « | »: the line under STEP prints them where the page's own line there is bare; and [n, STEP's pick 1 words, 1], one per place where STEP's own reading stands, call 4's category, a pair among them: the line under STEP prints them whatever today's line is, steps_reading_stands); has.step counts the places where the line under STEP as it rests draws a line (step_line_rests_bare); no second source

followed.what: the rows the tables name that are not in the store as named, each where the row-strikes record says it went since the store v1.2 read (tools/row-strikes-follow-v1.mjs): moved to another key and found there, with the picks that name it; struck, and named by no pick (v1.2 re-pointed them); withheld, with the picks that name it, which stand on their other rows or on the source's own words. found_once and found_more_than_once count the rows found as named

receipt_v1_says.why: receipt-v1's own counts of variants and alternatives are not those of its book files; the counts held are receipt-v1.1's (question 2 to the corpus lane, answered in relay v195: they were counted before the builder joined picks of one entry and words)

totals.what: summed over the books: has, the places where each source has a line (for STEP, where its line as it rests draws one: step_line_rests_bare); fills and second_fills, as shape.index counts them; shares, has (own) and second_fills (second) over the places

step_leaves.what: places where STEP has no pick (its pick 1 no line pick, and no place pieces that answer) and the word is not ketiv/qere; the index carries each with the other sources' lines. A place where STEP has a pick and its line as it rests is bare is none of them (step_line_rests_bare): its second does not fill it

rest_fills.what: STEP's leaves its second source (worked out with every source on) fills: the lines the second moves on a first visit

step_words.what: places that are not ketiv/qere, whose zone place pieces do not answer, where STEP's pick 1 is a line pick of its reading (kind r), and that the corpus lane's call 4 (relay v189) does not write with « | »: the index carries each with its words, and the line under STEP prints them, credited to STEP (M4), where the page's own line there is bare (the owner's question 2 of 14 November, recommendation B); a pick naming no row, or naming a row the entry gate withholds, prints so too (relay v195, sections 2 and 8). Which of them are bare is the page's: today's line is worked out on the page. HELD (held_split): where call 4 writes STEP's words with « | », STEP reads one written word as two TAHOT words and its pick 1 is the first of them only, so the index carries no STEP words there and the line keeps today's until the lane says how STEP's line reads (its open question 1); held counts those places that would else be here, listed the places call 4 writes so; where today's line at one of them is bare, the line under STEP draws nothing there (step_line_rests_bare). The places where STEP's own reading stands (call 4's category, steps_reading_stands) are among them too, each whatever its pieces and at a pair as well, with its words marked as standing

steps_reading_stands.what: the places of the corpus lane's call 4 (relay v189: data/audit-calls/calls-v1/, held to data/default-picks/PIN.json's held_split_v189), each by the class the bake reads at the zone word: stands where the list's action is steps_words_are_the_line, STEP's words hold no « | » and the zone word is not a pair whose read form is several words (kq.words_read); there the line under STEP is STEP's own pick 1, credited to STEP, whatever today's line is, and the index carries it as [n, words, 1]. Held by class: held_split (« | »: the owner's question 2, put back to the lane), none (the list's action), read_form_of_several_words (v192's read words carry those places). letters_equal: the zone word carries the list's letters; words_equal: at a place that stands, STEP's pick 1 after the mends is the list's words byte for byte; were_bare_before: the places that stand where the line under STEP rested bare before (pairs whose record draws no line)

step_line_rests_bare.what: places where STEP has a pick (its pick 1 a line pick) and its line as it rests draws nothing: its own words are never drawn at a pair (ketiv/qere: the pair keeps today's line) or at a place call 4 writes with « | » (held), and where the place pieces do not answer, today's line stands there; where the record of the resting lines holds no line over the word, that line is bare. Such a place is not counted in has.step, is no place STEP leaves (its second does not fill it), and counts in no fill of STEP's or by STEP; the other sources' has and fills count it as anywhere else, as the page prints their lines there. Read off the records as they stand (records); the default sources move nothing at these places, so the record's line there is today's whether or not it was read with them laid

picks_printed.what: under each first source, with its second for each book (worked out with every source on), the pills the card prints for the source whose words the line prints: the first's pick 1, and its picks 2..n with words, where it has a line; its second's where the second fills. Under STEP: its pick 1 where its own words print (step_words, where the page's own line is bare: the record of the resting lines draws no line over the word, a record of the page before the default sources were laid, or draws STEP's words as the line draws them under STEP's credit, M4, where no TAHOT row under a key the card asks there is drawn so, which would make the line today's), its picks 2..n said as text and not as pills, and its second's pick 1 at the places STEP leaves; under the others, STEP as the second prints its pick 1, and its picks 2..n as pills, where its own words print. Each pill by the rows its pick names, as the corpus lane names them (its own source's rows that print its words where there are any, else every row under its key that prints them): a row of its own source, another source's row only, or none; how many of them a row they name, standing under a key the card asks at the place (the word's own, or one of its pieces'), prints whole, read as the card reads a pill (a closing stop dropped, case folded, a "/" a joint or kept whole, the made spaces closed); and made, the pills no row of the pill's own source that the served store holds under a key the card asks prints whole: the card makes a row of the source's own words for each, credited to it. Made is the least the card makes: where the card's gates (the pointing, the entry, the names) withhold the row that prints a pill, or a ledger's division prints it in parts, the card makes that pill too; those are not judged here. The corpus lane's receipt-v1 counts every pick of v1 by the rows it names (its picks_printed)

runs_read_whole.what: the lines at rest over more than one word (a joined run's one line, as the records of the resting lines keep it), with the words under them, and for each source at how many of those lines it has a line at every word, at some, or at none. A run keeps its joined line at rest only where some word of it has no reading of its own at the place (its place pieces, or STEP's words where STEP's own reading stands; a bridged mark set aside): every other run reads its words one by one, the joined reading a press away (run-reads-its-words-rule-v1, question 8, taken). So these are the runs held so; on the page a source other than STEP takes such a run only where it has a line at every word, and under STEP the run's own line stands

place_reading_answers.what: places where STEP's pick 1 is no line pick, the word is not ketiv/qere, and the zone's place pieces all carry words: STEP has a line there (the place reading), so nothing is filled

signs.what: pick 1s (for UBS, each piece's pick 1) whose words are a sign or a stop alone, by source and text: no pick for the line, printed on the card as given

lists_beside_v1_2.what: the lists receipt-v1.2 issues beside the picks, each held to v1.2's picks at its places and counted; none moves a line (the line under STEP prints the ledger's words, credited to STEP, whatever a pick's row); the two branches rest off and are not baked

line_picks.what: each source's line pick and its named rows. For MACULA, UBS and BDB it is the pick that prints the source's line, at every place the source has one (has). For STEP it is its pick 1 wherever that is a line pick, a pair and a place where its line as it rests is bare among them (step_line_rests_bare); the line under STEP prints its words only where today's line is bare (step_words), and today's line, under its own chip, stands elsewhere. Its named rows: none, or a first named row whose source is not the pick's own (M4 for STEP's reading, M19 for its variants and alternatives, M3, M18, M46)
